content.short: FinchPay is a payment infrastructure provider offering seamless crypto purchase widgets for the TON ecosystem.
content.description: FinchPay is a dedicated payment service provider that offers streamlined fiat-to-crypto on-ramp solutions for the TON blockchain. It provides easy-to-integrate widgets and APIs that allow dApps, wallets, and websites to offer their users a simple way to purchase Toncoin (TON) using bank cards and other payment methods. FinchPay's focus on a smooth, white-label experience and high conversion rates makes it an ideal partner for TON projects looking to provide their users with a frictionless onboarding process without leaving their own platform.
